purpose: Test whether the Train-side unknown-pool composition explains the E194 finding that LOSO-1 (one unknown identity per fold) has no predictive power for Test S1 (five unregistered identities). Implements leave-k-out (k = 1, 2, 5, 10) with a strict protocol: task-wise standardisation, the PCA basis and the prototypes use only the 20-k registered identities' fit rows; the held-out block is excluded from every fitted statistic. For every k and every gate candidate it reports the fold-internal unknown rejection (a = 0.90), the pooled AUROC and the Test S1 / S2 readings, then measures the cross-gate Spearman rank correlation between the Train-side reading and Test S1.

protocol.threshold_rule: tau = quantile(fold known scores, 1 - a); known = the 20-k registered identities' 0.6<frac<=0.8 rows, unknown = the k held-out identities' same window

2.note: C(20,2) = 190 < the requested 200, so the full enumeration is used, not a 200-fold sample

5.note: C(20,5) = 15504, 200 distinct folds sampled with seed 20261116+5

10.note: C(20,10) = 184756, 100 distinct folds sampled with seed 20261116+10

e65.note: both variants share one z-transform and one eigendecomposition per fold

wccn.source: E192 WCCN distance-ratio gate, reimplemented exactly as in E195

fusion_normalisation: Each stream is fold-z-scored with the mean / sd of that fold's known block before the weighted sum, so the equal weights are equal in fold-standardised units and the single-gate readings are invariant to this step. Train-only: the held-out identities never enter the mean / sd.

gates.e183_note: E183 three-view fusion is included for k=1 only: its head is retrained per fold from 19 identities (10 reps x pseudo-unknown sampling), so a leave-k>1 head would have to be retrained 490 more times. Its k=1 arrays are read from the E195 cache so the E183 row is comparable to the E195 loso_strict reading but is not available for k>1.

reporting.test_official: N/A - Test has no identity labels; AUC/F1/C/RA/ASafeR/U/Score are not computable
reporting.session_usage: all Test scores are computed before the Session column is read; Session only splits S1 / S2 for the audit
reporting.predictive_power: cross-gate Spearman rank correlation between the leave-k Train reading and the Test reading, plus the mean absolute deviation
reporting.decomposition: A = leave-1 (unknown pool 1, gallery 19); B = leave-5 instrument with per-identity unknown readings (pool 1, gallery 15); C = leave-5 (pool 5, gallery 15). B vs C isolates the unknown-pool size at a fixed instrument; A vs B varies the gallery size at a fixed pool of 1.
